ryans.name: Ryan Helsley
ryans.title: American professional baseball pitcher for the Baltimore Orioles; former All-Star closer and citizen of the Cherokee Nation
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Dalton Helsley** (born July 18, 1994) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Baltimore Orioles of Major League Baseball [1]. A right-handed reliever, he was the St. Louis Cardinals' closer, an All-Star in 2022, and the 2024 National League Reliever of the Year after a club-record 49 saves [1]. On October 29, 2026, he exercised a $14 million player option to stay with Baltimore for 2027, after an elbow injury cut short his first season with the team [2].
known_for: 49 saves in 2024, a Cardinals single-season record
